items.source: Place a cache_control breakpoint on the last tool result message of the request so that tool outputs are cached across tool-calling rounds. Takes effect with AnthropicCacheStrategy.CONVERSATION_HISTORY.
items.translation: 在请求的最后一个工具结果消息上设置一个 `cache_control` 断点，以便跨工具调用轮次缓存工具输出。此设置在采用 AnthropicCacheStrategy.CONVERSATION_HISTORY 时生效。
